The Senior Civil Structural Engineer will lead and execute structural engineering tasks for brownfield projects in the petrochemical and oil & gas sectors. This role

compliant solutions tailored to existing infrastructure.
Strong understanding of international codes and standards (Eurocodes, AISC, ASCE, Singapore codes, API, PIP,etc.).

Experience in adequacy check of existing structure & its foundations, onshore structure Skid, Off shore analysis and design(eg Helideck structure), etc
Experience in design of Modular structure.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Excellent communication and report-writing skills.
Knowledge of preparation and review of Civil and Structural design in compliance with Quality System.

Develop and review engineering deliverables including calculations, drawings, and specifications.
Ensure compliance with regional codes (e.g., Eurocodes, AISC, ASCE, API, etc.) and client standards.
Evaluate existing structures for load capacity, corrosion, and retrofitting needs.
Design supports for piping, cable trays, and equipment considering space constraints and legacy systems.
Coordinate with disciplines like piping, instrumentation, and electrical to align structural needs.
Prepare technical reports, inspection summaries, and design justifications.
Review and approve drawings, calculations, and vendor documents.

Review and approve drawings, calculations, and vendor documents.
Resolve construction feedback and RFI related issues for issued deliverables

metadata.subject: TPC - DCS Testing - Bangalore - 518861

content.normalized:
Dear Partner,
Kindly share quality profiles with
@Praveen Kumar S A
with priority.
Requirement
Overall exp- 3 - 7 Yrs.
Open Positions- 2
Any domain specification-
Industrial Automation
Qualification Criteria- Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation/Electronics & Communication
Mandatory Skills-
Strong Domain Knowledge on industrial process (Power/ O&G), sound knowledge of communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, IEC60870, IEC61850, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, OPCUA etc., working experience in DCS preferably Honeywell Experion DCS, SCADA solutions and PLC systems, PLC ladder programming/FBD and other languages as per IEC61131-3 standard.
Bill Rate per month for TPC (in terms of INR) – 100000/Month
Work location – Bangalore
Details JD -
Key Responsibilities:
• Candidate would be responsible for creating test plans, test procedures as for Honeywell NPI requirements of the Process Industry and Compliance regulations and should ensure full coverage.
• Candidate will be responsible for the overall System level Test Coverage and reduction in Post Release defects to the Customer/End User.
• Candidate will be responsible for On-time delivery of project/group objectives and influences project level productivity.
• Candidate will bring forward for product innovations, ideas, Proof of Concepts and product enhancements that add business value.
• Candidate will also drive the culture of ensuring the test engineers in the team are using test environment that almost replicate customer sites and develop better customer scenarios for validation.
• Candidate will need to ensure test procedures are automated & simulations defined wherever applicable that should have in depth test coverage as well as reduce cycle time.
• Candidate will need to drive Productivity improvement and DOE techniques to take intelligent risks without compromising Quality.
• He/ She would be responsible for interacting with key Stakeholders such as Architects, Program Management, Development Leads and Test System Engineer.
• He/ She should be able to support/resolve queries from Project Engineering teams and TAC.
• He/ She should be able to drive improvements in Test methodologies inline with the best in class Standards.
Must have:
Bachelor’s Degree in Instrumentation/Electronics & Communication
Industrial Experience of 3 to 7 Years
We Value:
• Candidate should have 2 to 4 years’ experience in the field of industrial automation.
• Candidate is required to have Strong Domain Knowledge on industrial process (Power/ O&G) and its applications.
• He/ she should have sound knowledge of different communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, IEC60870, IEC61850, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, OPCUA etc. for third party interfaces and for field device integration.
• Candidate should have working experience in DCS preferably Honeywell Experion DCS, SCADA solutions and PLC systems.
• Candidate should have working knowledge on PLC ladder programming/FBD and other languages described in IEC61131-3 standard.
• Candidate should have detail knowledge on Operating System as Windows/Linux also better understanding on the platform (DELL).
• Candidate should have hands on working experience in configuring the PLC, RTU, DCS systems in either commissioning or test environments.
• Added advantage if Candidate have working experience in test automation tools.
• Should have very good Logical reasoning and Analytical skills.
• Experience working in Virtualization.
• Very good communication, collaborative skills, Debugging/Problem Solving Skill.
Preferred Skills:
• Having Knowledge Industrial experience in process or power plant and knowledge of critical control loops.
• Having Knowledge/ working Skills in Honeywell Experion PKS.
• Knowledge of Configuration Studio and Control Builder engineering tools and usage of C200/C300 Controllers
• Knowledge of Server and client topology and having work experience on FTE(Fault Tolerant Ethernet).
• He/ She should have Knowledge of Alarms, Trend, History, Reports, Batch process and basic networking will be added advantage

Subject:
TPC-Mobility-EE Lab Technician- Bangalore
Dear Partner,
Kindly share quality profiles with
@Kiran N
by 12 Noon today.
Overall exp-5 Yrs
Open Positions- 01
Qualification Criteria-
Diploma / bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, or related discipline.
Bill Rate per month for TPC(in terms of INR)- 80K
Work location-
Bengaluru
Details JD-
We are seeking a skilled and detail‑oriented
EE Lab Technician
to manage and operate our Electrical & Electronics engineering laboratory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end‑to‑end lab management, including equipment handling, inventory control (SCM), PCB assembly support, soldering, board builds, testing, 5S, and documentation. Strong knowledge of electronic components and hands‑on hardware experience is essential.
Key Responsibilities
1. Lab Operations & Management
Oversee daily operations of the EE lab, ensuring cleanliness, safety, and compliance with lab protocols.
Maintain and calibrate equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DMMs, soldering stations, and rework tools.
Ensure proper ESD safety measures are followed at all times.
Set up test benches and support engineers during development and validation activities.
2. Supply Chain & Inventory Management (SCM)
Manage inventory of electronic components, tools, and consumables.
Track stock levels, generate purchase requests, and coordinate with vendors.
Maintain accurate documentation of material movement and lab assets.
Identify shortages proactively and handle replacement/repair of faulty equipment.
3. Soldering, Assembly & Board Build
Perform soldering and rework (through‑hole and SMD, including fine‑pitch components).
Assemble prototype PCBs, wiring harnesses, and system-level builds.
Support board bring-up activities with basic measurements and troubleshooting.
Follow assembly guidelines, BOMs, and engineering drawings accurately.
4. Testing & Debugging Support
Carry out functional tests on circuits and prototype boards.
Assist engineers in debugging using lab instruments.
Record test data and provide structured feedback to the design team.
Ensure proper labeling, traceability, and documentation of tested units.
5. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain lab documentation including test logs, equipment manuals, calibration reports, and component datasheets.
Support audit and compliance requirements related to lab safety and equipment.
Prepare reports on inventory, usage, and build status.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or related discipline.
2+ years hands-on experience working in an electronics lab environment.
Strong soldering skills (SMD, BGA rework experience is a plus).
Good understanding of electronic components, schematics, and PCB layouts.
Experience with lab instruments (oscilloscope, power supply, function generator, etc.).
Familiarity with inventory management tools or basic SCM processes.
Good documentation skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
IPC‑610 / IPC‑7711 certification (optional but beneficial).
Experience with proto builds for embedded systems / power electronics.
Basic troubleshooting and circuit analysis skills.
Knowledge of ESD standards and safety protocols.
Soft Skills
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Problem-solving mindset with an eye for quality.
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment

Subject:
FW: 3PT Demand__Salesforce Identity Provider (IdP)_ITC Infotech
HI All,
Please find below the JD attached . kindly help us with the profiles at the earliest .
3PT (2months)
Budget – 1.8 LPM
Experience – 6-8years
Notice period – Immediate
Remote
Role Overview
A
Salesforce Identity Provider (IdP) Specialist/Developer
is responsible for configuring and managing Salesforce as an
Identity Provider
, enabling secure authentication and
Single Sign-On (SSO)
across multiple applications.
They ensure users can log in once and securely access connected systems using standards like SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.
🔹
Key Responsibilities
1. Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Configure Salesforce as an Identity Provider (IdP)
Manage user authentication and authorization
Implement
Single Sign-On (SSO)
across enterprise apps
2. SSO & Federation Setup
Set up and manage:
SAML 2.0 SSO
OAuth 2.0 flows
OpenID Connect (OIDC)
Integrate Salesforce with:
Enterprise apps (HRMS, ERP)
External portals and third-party systems
3. User Management & Provisioning
Configure:
Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning
User federation IDs
Automate user lifecycle (onboarding/offboarding)
4. Security & Compliance
Implement:
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
IP restrictions and login policies
Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards
5. Troubleshooting & Monitoring
Diagnose login/SSO issues
Analyze authentication logs and debug failures
Maintain uptime and reliability of identity services
6. Documentation & Collaboration
Document SSO configurations and flows
Work with security teams, DevOps, and application owners
🔹
Required Skills
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of:
SAML 2.0
OAuth 2.0
OpenID Connect (OIDC)
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Identity features
Knowledge of authentication flows and tokens (JWT, assertions)
Basic Salesforce admin knowledge:
Profiles, Permission Sets
Users & Roles
Tools & Platforms
Experience with identity platforms like:
Okta
Azure Active Directory
Familiarity with API testing tools (Postman)
Soft Skills
Strong troubleshooting ability
Attention to security details
Cross-team communication
🔹
Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Certifications:
Administrator
Identity & Access Management Designer
Experience in enterprise IAM architecture
Knowledge of Zero Trust security concepts

We are seeking an experienced Automotive Hardware Engineer to lead the design, development, and validation of electronic hardware for next generation automotive systems. Hardware Design & Development
Lead the architecture, design, and development of automotive ECUs, sensors, actuators, and control electronics.

ISO 26262 (Functional Safety)
AEC-Q100/200 (Component Qualification)
ISO 16750 (Environmental Requirements)
EMC/EMI standards (CISPR, ISO 11452)

Testing & Validation
Lead validation of hardware designs through:
Environmental testing (thermal, vibration, humidity).
Reliability & durability analysis.
EMC/EMI testing.
Perform root cause analysis and resolve hardware failures during validation or field issues.
Technical Leadership
Guide junior engineers through design reviews, testing strategies, and best practices.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (software, mechanical, systems, manufacturing).
Drive technical decision-making and deliver high-quality documentation.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work with suppliers for component selection, sourcing, and cost optimization.
Coordinate with manufacturing and quality teams for product industrialization.
Support customer discussions, requirement clarifications, and design feasibility assessments.

content.normalized:

Requirement  – 523288 – Ultrasound System Testing
Overall exp- 7 - 10 Yrs
Open Positions- 1
Any domain specification-
Medical
Qualification Criteria- B.E
Mandatory Skills-
Bill Rate per month for TPC (in terms of INR) – 90000/Month
Work location – Bangalore
Details JD –
Role Summary
We are seeking for Medical device System Test Engineer to plan, execute, and automate functional and performance testing for diagnostic ultrasound systems and probes. You will validate image quality, safety, acoustic output, and clinical workflow across modalities (e.g., B‑mode, M‑mode, Color Doppler, PW/CW Doppler, 3D/4D, Elastography), ensure standards compliance, and drive release readiness in a regulated medical device environment. The ideal candidate blends clinical understanding, hardware/system acumen, strong test discipline, and data-driven problem solving.
What You'll Do
Test Plan, Test Design & Execution
Author and maintain verification & validation test plans, protocols, and reports with full traceability to requirements and risk controls.
Execute tests covering image quality (axial/lateral resolution, contrast resolution, uniformity, depth of penetration, harmonic/compounding), Doppler accuracy (velocity scale, angle correction, wall filter), thermal & mechanical indices, UI/UX, and workflow.
Use tissue‑mimicking and Doppler flow phantoms to quantify system performance; analyse results statistically and trend over builds.
Connectivity & Data
Validate DICOM storage/print, worklist (HL7), PACS connectivity, and image metadata integrity; ensure PHI handling aligns with HIPAA/GDPR.
Safety & Compliance
Verify compliance with IEC 60601-2-37 (ultrasound safety), IEC 60601-1/EMC, IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), ISO 14971 (risk),
Conduct/participate in risk-based testing tied to hazard analyses and post‑market feedback.
Defect Management & Collaboration
Log, triage, and drive defects to closure with R&D, Systems, Acoustics, and Clinical teams; provide high‑fidelity repro data (steps, logs, captures).
Partner with clinical specialists/sonographers to translate clinical use cases into test scenarios.
Safety & Compliance
Verify compliance with IEC 60601-2-37 (ultrasound safety), IEC 60601-1/EMC, IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), ISO 14971 (risk),
Release & Documentation
Own test summary report, test evidence for design reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions; contribute to labelling verification and IFU reviews.
Support manufacturing test transfer and service diagnostics where applicable.
Nice to Have
Lead test strategy for programs; coach junior engineers; own product V&V budget/schedule.
Define acceptance criteria, sampling plans, and confidence levels for design freezes and releases.
Excellent communication and cross‑functional teamwork skills.
Preferred/Bonus
Familiarity with IEC 60601-2-37, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366, ISO 13485 QMS.
Knowledge of probe technologies (phased array, linear, convex), cable/connector testing, and probe lifecycle reliability.
Tools & Equipment You May Use
Phantoms: AIUM-type grayscale/geometry phantoms, Doppler flow phantom, uniformity/contrast targets, elastography phantoms.
Software: DICOM Tools, DOORS, Code Beamer, Windchill, TeamTrack etc.

content.normalized:
Dear Partner,
Kindly share quality profiles with
@Kiran N
by 12 Noon today.
Overall exp-5 Yrs
Open Positions- 01
Qualification Criteria-
Diploma / bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, or related discipline.
Bill Rate per month for TPC(in terms of INR)- 80K
Work location-
Bengaluru
Details JD-
We are seeking a skilled and detail‑oriented
EE Lab Technician
to manage and operate our Electrical & Electronics engineering laboratory. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end‑to‑end lab management, including equipment handling, inventory control (SCM), PCB assembly support, soldering, board builds, testing, 5S, and documentation. Strong knowledge of electronic components and hands‑on hardware experience is essential.
Key Responsibilities
1. Lab Operations & Management
Oversee daily operations of the EE lab, ensuring cleanliness, safety, and compliance with lab protocols.
Maintain and calibrate equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DMMs, soldering stations, and rework tools.
Ensure proper ESD safety measures are followed at all times.
Set up test benches and support engineers during development and validation activities.
2. Supply Chain & Inventory Management (SCM)
Manage inventory of electronic components, tools, and consumables.
Track stock levels, generate purchase requests, and coordinate with vendors.
Maintain accurate documentation of material movement and lab assets.
Identify shortages proactively and handle replacement/repair of faulty equipment.
3. Soldering, Assembly & Board Build
Perform soldering and rework (through‑hole and SMD, including fine‑pitch components).
Assemble prototype PCBs, wiring harnesses, and system-level builds.
Support board bring-up activities with basic measurements and troubleshooting.
Follow assembly guidelines, BOMs, and engineering drawings accurately.
4. Testing & Debugging Support
Carry out functional tests on circuits and prototype boards.
Assist engineers in debugging using lab instruments.
Record test data and provide structured feedback to the design team.
Ensure proper labeling, traceability, and documentation of tested units.
5. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain lab documentation including test logs, equipment manuals, calibration reports, and component datasheets.
Support audit and compliance requirements related to lab safety and equipment.
Prepare reports on inventory, usage, and build status.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or related discipline.
2+ years hands-on experience working in an electronics lab environment.
Strong soldering skills (SMD, BGA rework experience is a plus).
Good understanding of electronic components, schematics, and PCB layouts.
Experience with lab instruments (oscilloscope, power supply, function generator, etc.).
Familiarity with inventory management tools or basic SCM processes.
Good documentation skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
IPC‑610 / IPC‑7711 certification (optional but beneficial).
Experience with proto builds for embedded systems / power electronics.
Basic troubleshooting and circuit analysis skills.
Knowledge of ESD standards and safety protocols.
Soft Skills
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Problem-solving mindset with an eye for quality.
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment

content.normalized:
Dear Partner,
Kindly share quality profiles with
@Praveen Kumar S A
at the earliest.
Requirement – 522748 – S C P – Broadband Testing
Overall exp- 5 - 7 Yrs
Open Positions- 1
Any domain specification-
Hardware
Qualification Criteria- B.E
Mandatory Skills- Broadband Testing (Java, Javascript, Python, Selenium, Robot Framework), BDD, Devops, Wifi protocols
Bill Rate per month for TPC (in terms of INR) – As per market standard
Work location – Bangalore
Details JD -
In the role of Software Quality Engineer (Broadband Release) you will be responsible for the Tooling and Test Automation Infrastructure. Experienced with automation tools and frameworks for test development, execution, and reporting. Maintaining test automation, including selecting appropriate tools, configuring environments, and integrating with version control systems.
•             BDD and Test Automation - Develop and execute high-quality test plans efficiently on RDK stacks while leveraging automation and tooling to detect defects quickly and ensure the reliability of test coverages.
•             BDD and Test Automation - Explore advanced topics such as test data management, scenario refactoring, and integrating BDD with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
•             Collaboration and Communication Skills - Practice agile methodologies to enhance teamwork and productivity. Participate in cross-functional activities such as joint sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospective meetings to foster alignment and shared understanding across teams.
What You'll Bring:
•
Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting languages ( e.g Java, Javascript, Python, Selenium, Robot Framework) for automating broadband testing process.
•             DevOps Practices experience where you will provide Full Life cycle Ownership, Comprehensive Solutioning. Observability and Oversight, Process Optimisation, Collaboration and Integration and Operationalisation.
•             Knowledge of Dual Band router - Wifi protocols, MapT IP Translator and Networking.
•             BDD and Test Automation and Infrastructure experience. Good understanding of Business-Driven Development Strategy.
•             Fully familiar with automation tools and frameworks for test development, execution and reporting.
•             Reliability Engineering and Test Coverage Optimisation. Explore strategies for optimizing test coverage, such as risk-based testing, equivalence partitioning, and prioritizing critical paths.

We are looking for TPC Robotics Engineer to design, develop, and deploy advanced robotic systems including Humanoid robots, Quadruped robots, and Cobots.
The role focuses on robot software development, perception, motion control, and system integration. Kindly find JD for your reference. Kindly share quality profiles with
@Pranati Paul
at the earliest.
Looking for immediate joiner Notice period : 15 Days.
Open Positions-2
Bill Rate-100000 max
Job Title: Robotics Engineer – ROS (Humanoid, Quadruped & Cobot)
Education & Experience
BE / BTech / ME / MTech in Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical
5–8  years of robotics software development experience
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain ROS / ROS2‑based robotic software
Implement perception, navigation, locomotion, and manipulation modules
Integrate sensors (LiDAR, camera, IMU, force‑torque) and actuators
Work on humanoid & quadruped locomotion and cobot arm control
Implement SLAM, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and grasping
Validate algorithms in Gazebo / Isaac Sim / simulation tools
Support robot deployment, testing, and customer demos
Required Skills
Strong experience in ROS / ROS2
Proficiency in C++ and Python
Hands‑on experience with real robotic systems
Solid understanding of:  Robot kinematics & dynamics, Control systems & Sensor fusion & localization
Experience on Linux (Ubuntu)
Preferred Experience
Humanoid or Quadruped robots
Cobots / robotic arms (MoveIt / MoveIt2)
AI/ML integration for robotics
NVIDIA Jetson / edge AI deployment
Industrial or automation environments

content.normalized:
Dear Staffing Partner,
Attached is step by step process for raising Invoice for your 3PT and OTP Candidate as applicable. Kindly follow the steps and adhere to below points.
Request your kind attention that henceforth;
all invoices of current month, need to be submitted on or before
11
th
Apr 2026
to the email address:
“
I3LVendor.Management@itcinfotech.com
”
Attaching a sample Invoice template. Kindly refer this while preparing the invoice.
NOTE: It might not need to be exact format. Please make sure all the fields are incorporated in the invoice.
Please mention the
Subject of your Invoice Submission mail
as “
Invoice for Service Period - _________ || Vendor Name - ___________
”
Statutory documents
(
Applicable only for 3PT Resources
) of invoices submitted in
Mar-26
(including remitted Challans) must be submitted
along with Apr-2026 Invoices
for all the active 3PT resources in respective months.
As there are multiple statutory documents pending from Partner Organisation, ITCI has received Non-Compliance notice during Audit and hence, collection of Statutory Documents (since April-2024) has become mandatory to ensure regulatory compliance
.
As per Agreement signed between Partner organization and ITCI, “STATUTORY COMPLIANCE DECLARATION” clearly mandates submission of statutory document by Partner Organization and it needs to be abided by.
Based on Below list of Statutory compliance acts, the following 6 documents are of immediate requirement.
i.
PF Registration Certificate
ii.
Challans, Monthly Returns, ECR Statements & TRRN Acknowledgement.
iii.
PF Form 11 in case PF is not applicable.
iv.
Declaration Letter for not applicability / exempted cases – PF, PT & ESIC”
v.
Combined - Master Roll and Form T (Wage Register) With seal and signature with ITC name and address on it.
vi.
CLRA Declaration Letter for not applicability
Kindly note that as per Clause 24.7 of Agreement and as per Clause 7.c) of Work Authorisation (Work Oder),
BGV report submission to ITCI within 21
st
days
from the Date Of Joining (DOJ) for any 3PT from your organization remains mandatory.
In case of any delay in submission of BGV report, processing of Invoice Payment will be delayed.
Also, we would like to inform that if there is any Red (failed) or Amber BGV for any 3PT from your Organization, Invoice Payment will be delayed, and ITCI internal process will be initiated either for exit or exception approval for the given BGV Non-Compliance.
Similarly, as per Clause 24.10. (d) of Agreement, return of ITCI owned IT Assets allocated to a given 3PT of your organization; within 2 weeks from the exit date of same 3PT remains mandatory.
In case of any delay in return of ITCI owned IT Assets allocated to a given 3PT, processing of Invoice Payment will be delayed.
Also, we request to
restrict the number of invoices submitted
in a given month for a given ‘Service Period’; to
ONE only
.
Thanks & Regards,
Likhita Bhattu
Vendor Management Team.
